1.content: F denotes free traversable floor; agents can occupy these cells without penalty.

2.content: H denotes hazardous terrain; agents can occupy these cells and receive zero reward per step; entering H does not terminate the episode.

3.content: G denotes the goal cell; entering G terminates the episode and yields a reward of 1.

4.content: Certain free cells (F) can transition into hazardous cells (H) after being occupied by the agent; the change persists for the remainder of the episode.

5.content: Non-goal cells (both F and H) yield a reward of 0 per step; only entering G gives reward 1 and terminates the episode.
